name: 2D Illustrated Explainer
summary: Hand-built vector objects in a single stage, each step changing the picture: diagrams that perform the idea. Friendly, legible and sequential.

identity.visual_language: flat vector objects with thick consistent strokes and a few accent colours
identity.illustration_style: geometric characters and objects, consistent line weight
identity.composition_philosophy: a single hero stage occupying most of the frame
identity.environment: plain light ground with subtle depth
identity.storytelling_conventions: objects move to show cause and effect

palette.contrast_strategy: charcoal on off-white; each accent has one meaning

composition.principles: hero stage 65%+ of the frame; annotations attach to objects

motion.grammar: Objects enter, connect, transform and carry the explanation; camera pushes toward what is being explained.

transitions.continuity: the carried object stays in frame

camera.language: gentle push and pan on the stage

motion.stillness_policy: No stillness while narration explains changing content.

rendering.strategy: Native HyperFrames compositions on the studio runtime; the default workspace path.

provenance.method: Authored rule set (prescribed). Derived from the style system's tokens, the workspace motion vocabulary and the technique records listed; not extracted from a single reference.
provenance.notes: Every value here is prescribed intent, not a measurement. Evidence of use is recorded under 'validation' only after a render exists.

weaknesses: Turns into a dashboard of cards unless the stage is one connected picture.
Illustration consistency is hard to maintain if some objects are generated.
example_scenes: A packet travelling along a path between two nodes while a label counts the hops.
